description: Source code for ArrowWriter object and related classes, implementing data writing to Apache Arrow vectors within Spark SQL's execution engine.

classes.name: ArrowWriter
classes.description: Main class for writing data into Arrow vectors, managing schema, row count, and field writers.

classes.name: ArrowFieldWriter
classes.description: Abstract class defining interface for writing individual fields into Arrow vectors.

classes.name: BooleanWriter
classes.description: Writes boolean values into BitVector.

classes.name: ByteWriter
classes.description: Writes byte (tinyint) values into TinyIntVector.

classes.name: ShortWriter
classes.description: Writes short (smallint) values into SmallIntVector.

classes.name: IntegerWriter
classes.description: Writes integer values into IntVector.

classes.name: LongWriter
classes.description: Writes long (bigint) values into BigIntVector.

classes.name: FloatWriter
classes.description: Writes float values into Float4Vector.

classes.name: DoubleWriter
classes.description: Writes double values into Float8Vector.

classes.name: DecimalWriter
classes.description: Writes decimal values into DecimalVector with specified precision and scale.

classes.name: StringWriter
classes.description: Writes UTF8 string values into VarCharVector.

classes.name: LargeStringWriter
classes.description: Writes UTF8 string values into LargeVarCharVector.

classes.name: BinaryWriter
classes.description: Writes binary data into VarBinaryVector.

classes.name: LargeBinaryWriter
classes.description: Writes binary data into LargeVarBinaryVector.

classes.name: DateWriter
classes.description: Writes date values into DateDayVector.

classes.name: TimestampWriter
classes.description: Writes timestamp with timezone into TimeStampMicroTZVector.

classes.name: TimestampNTZWriter
classes.description: Writes timestamp without timezone into TimeStampMicroVector.

classes.name: TimeWriter
classes.description: Writes time values into TimeNanoVector.

classes.name: ArrayWriter
classes.description: Writes array data into ListVector, delegating element writing.

classes.name: StructWriter
classes.description: Writes struct data into StructVector, managing child field writers.

classes.name: GeographyWriter
classes.description: Writes geography data into StructVector, serializing geometries.

classes.name: GeometryWriter
classes.description: Writes geometry data into StructVector, serializing geometries.

classes.name: MapWriter
classes.description: Writes map data into MapVector, managing key-value pairs.

classes.name: NullWriter
classes.description: Handles null values for vectors that support nulls.

classes.name: IntervalYearWriter
classes.description: Writes interval year data into IntervalYearVector.

classes.name: DurationWriter
classes.description: Writes duration data into DurationVector.

classes.name: IntervalMonthDayNanoWriter
classes.description: Writes interval month/day/nano data into IntervalMonthDayNanoVector.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ArrowWriter from schema and configuration parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ArrowWriter from an existing VectorSchemaRoot.

methods.name: createFieldWriter
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate ArrowFieldWriter based on vector's data type.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a single InternalRow into the Arrow vectors.

methods.name: sizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates total size in bytes of the written data.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes writing, setting row count and finishing child writers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the writer to initial state for reuse.
